name: Fortunatus
title: Faithful Messenger from Corinth
summary: Fortunatus was a Christian from the church in Corinth who, together with Stephanas and Achaicus, traveled to Paul in Ephesus. He likely brought a letter from the church and information about conditions there. Paul mentions him with gratitude for his service and encouragement.

keyEvents.title: Visit to Paul in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: Fortunatus traveled with Stephanas and Achaicus from Corinth to Paul in Ephesus, likely to bring a letter from the church and seek counsel on important matters.

keyEvents.title: Brought Encouragement to Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul expresses joy at their arrival, as they made up for the absence of the church and refreshed his spirit.

keyEvents.title: Recognized by Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul urges the church in Corinth to recognize and respect men like Fortunatus, Stephanas, and Achaicus for their faithful service.
